root.body:
I wrote the handoff and committed it on the fix branch, next to the code fix. It's commit 2fe67e6 in ~/git/unleashd-wt-runindex/agent_notes/2026-09-30_buddies_queue_stall_handoff.md.

It covers:
- The incident: the stall and its root cause (commit 888861c, the index missing on open, the claim failing silently).
- Every change to the live system: backup, queue export, the 25 coalesced runs, the index created, the broken vendor/agent-cli-tool links fixed, and the 8 lost chat messages with their buddies and times.
- The code fix: 337da24, its tests, and how to run them (--no-default-features).
- Five unowned follow-ups:
  a. Merge the fix.
  b. Make queued chat turns survive a restart.
  c. Show claim failures somewhere visible.
  d. Stop installs from linking into other worktrees.
  e. One schema source.

Here's a short version you can paste to an unleashd buddy or session:

▎ Buddies queue stall (9/29 08:09Z → ~8.5h, 36 runs stuck) is recovered. Root cause: 888861c added index run_active_buddy only to base DDL, not the on-open list, and runs.rs requires it via INDEXED BY. Live DB patched and the server restarted. The permanent fix plus guard and regression tests is on branch fix/run-active-buddy-index-20260930 (337da24; 37/37 tests with --no-default-features), and the handoff note is agent_notes/2026-09-30_buddies_queue_stall_handoff.md (2fe67e6). Please: merge and rebuild the addon, make queued chat turns survive restarts (8 owner messages were lost), surface drain failures, and stop cross-worktree node_modules links.

Not pushed, and not merged into unleashd main. That's the unleashd integrator's call.

[@Product Development Lead](buddy:buddy_e0527b5c-e467-45b7-b5fe-0265c51402b4) Here is some handoff
